item.title: Big Wave Surfer Justine Dupont Fractures Vertebrae During Thriller at Killers Event
item.description: Big wave surfer Justine Dupont endured a brutal back injury during the Thriller at Killers competition, as she explained in a social media post.

item.title: Kai Lenny Wing Surfing Jaws Is So Incredible It Looks Fake
item.description: Kai Lenny is very comfortable in situations that most would be uncomfortable in. Take giant Jaws, for example. He's wing surfing it like it ain't a big deal.

item.title: Gabriel Medina Has a New Sponsor, But You Haven’t Heard of It
item.description: Gabriel Medina announced a new partnership with a Brazilian company. But what's next for Medina? Nike? Monster? We Investigate that question here.

item.title: Dylan Graves Finds Frigid Perfection Above the Arctic Circle
item.description: Dylan Graves is a man who would go to the end of the Earth for a perfect wave, and when he went to the Arctic Circle, he proved it.

item.title: Skier Dies Attempting Run Down Mammoth’s ‘Dropout Chute 2’
item.description: A skier died at Mammoth Mountain last week after a fall down the resort's infamous Dropout 2. The accident marks the fourth death at Mammoth this winter.

item.title: Sofia Mulanovich Has Launched a National Surf Tour in Peru
item.description: Peru's former world champion, Sofia Mulanovich, has a new project in the works to create a professional platform for surfers in her home country.

item.title: Winter Olympians’ Medals Keep Breaking, But There’s a Fix
item.description: It must sting a little to reach the pinnacle of achievement in your sport, only to have the symbol of that achievement promptly fall apart.

item.title: Brazil Surf Industry Pros Say the End of the Brazilian Storm Is Near
item.description: The Brazilian Storm has dominated the past decade of professional surfing, but industry leaders in Brazil think the future is not looking as bright.

item.title: American Skier Goes Off Course in Same Spot as Vonn’s Catastrophic Injury
item.description: Two days after Lindsey Vonn's Olympic run ended in a gut-wrenching crash, another American skier nearly fell victim to the same course – in the same spot.

item.title: California Ski Area Shuts Down Due to ‘Unseasonable Warmth’
item.description: Mt. Shasta Ski Park announced this week that it's shutting down indefinitely due to low snow coverage, joining other resorts in the area impacted by weather.
